title: Upward Technologies vs Dutch custom software agencies
content_html:
When comparing Upward Technologies vs Dutch custom software agencies, traditional agencies excel at large bespoke web and mobile applications with extensive design teams. Upward Technologies builds custom software, automations, and AI agents for operational workflows, starting every project with a three-week paid scoping phase, and hosts and runs what it delivers.

What Dutch custom software agencies are good at

The Netherlands has an established market of digital agencies and custom software shops. These firms range from boutique consultancies to large development houses in cities such as Amsterdam, Utrecht, and Eindhoven.

Dutch custom software agencies are strong choices when a company needs consumer-facing mobile apps, deep creative branding, or large multidisciplinary project teams. They typically provide:

  • Dedicated design units focused on user research, wireframing, and custom consumer design systems.
  • Large engineering teams capable of staffing complex multi-year development projects.
  • Experience building public web portals, customer-facing mobile applications, and high-traffic consumer platforms.
  • Comprehensive agency services that combine software engineering with digital marketing and visual branding.

When an organisation requires a bespoke public application, a large team of frontend specialists, or end-to-end creative direction, an established agency remains the logical selection.

What Upward Technologies does differently

Upward Technologies (upwardtech.nl) is a software company based in Breda. The company does not build consumer apps or run creative branding campaigns. Instead, it builds custom software, automated workflows, and AI agents for Dutch mid-market businesses and SMEs that lose hours to spreadsheets, retyping, and disconnected tools.

Several distinct operational principles guide this work:

1. A defined three-week scoping phase. Every engagement begins with a paid three-week scoping phase before any development begins. This process evaluates technical requirements, data flows, and workflow bottlenecks. It concludes with an architectural document that the client can take to any supplier, along with a clear go or no-go decision. It does not produce a prototype or a working agent.
2. Operational focus over agency design. Rather than public branding or marketing sites, development focuses on internal tools, ERP and CRM integrations, client portals, and workflow automation.
3. Integrated hosting and maintenance. Upward Technologies designs and builds custom software, and also hosts and runs the applications it delivers. Teams do not have to manage servers or infrastructure internally.
4. Targeted software products. In addition to custom development, Upward Technologies builds specialized software. These products include Bookwise for Dutch holding company bookkeeping (live since 1 October 2026), Transfer for secure file transfers, DocSign for electronic signatures, Reach for B2B outreach, GTM for AI go-to-market drafts, Assure for ISO 27001 document control (currently in beta), and ERIS (an on-premises business software suite entering beta on 16 November 2026).

When operational teams evaluate their systems, off-the-shelf software often fails to match existing business rules. As discussed in Why Standard Project Controls Software SaaS Misses the Mark for Growing Teams, growing companies regularly outgrow rigid tools and turn to custom architecture to keep data connected.

Which one should you pick

Selecting between an agency and Upward Technologies depends on the nature of your software project, your end users, and your operational priorities.

Choose a Dutch custom software agency if:

  • You need a consumer-facing iOS or Android application.
  • Your project demands dedicated UI/UX research teams, brand identity development, or marketing design.
  • You have a large budget requiring a team of dozens of contractors and engineers working in parallel.
  • You want an agency that handles both your public brand marketing and your development backlog.

Choose Upward Technologies if:

  • You are an operations, finance, or IT lead at a Dutch SME or mid-market business losing manual hours to spreadsheets and retyping.
  • You need internal software, automated workflows, AI agents, or system integrations that connect your existing CRM and ERP.
  • You prefer a three-week paid scoping phase to establish architectural feasibility and costs before committing to full production.
  • You want the team that designed and built your software to host, monitor, and run it over the long term.

FAQ

How should companies compare Upward Technologies vs Dutch custom software agencies?

Compare them based on project goals. Traditional agencies excel at consumer-facing applications, branding, and large design-led projects. Upward Technologies concentrates on internal operational tools, ERP and CRM integrations, automated workflows, and AI agents.

Does Upward Technologies hold compliance certifications?

Upward Technologies does not currently hold ISO 27001, ISO 9001, NEN 7510, ISAE 3000/3402, or ISO 42001 certifications. Certification processes for ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 are in progress, while others remain planned.

Can Upward Technologies build consumer mobile apps?

No. Upward Technologies focuses on operational software, automated workflows, AI agents, and integrations for business teams. Companies seeking consumer mobile applications or visual branding are better served by traditional Dutch design and development agencies.

What happens during the three-week scoping phase?

The project begins with a three-week paid scoping review to analyze requirements and architecture. It concludes with an independent technical document that can be handed to any vendor, followed by a go or no-go decision. It does not produce a prototype or a working agent.

Does ERIS replace custom development today?

ERIS is not yet publicly released. A beta program begins on 16 November 2026, followed by a planned general release on 11 January 2027. Teams interested in local, on-premises applications can register as design partners.
